name: The Lodge at  Primland,  Auberge Collection
insider_take: This 12,000-acre wilderness sanctuary sits atop the Blue Ridge Mountains, where luxury meets untamed nature in Virginia's breathtaking highlands.
whats_special: The Lodge at Primland features its own private observatory with professional-grade telescopes, plus an impressive collection of outdoor adventures including a championship golf course designed by Donald Steel, clay shooting, and falconry experiences. The property is also home to a unique tree house spa treatment room suspended 15 feet above ground.
pro_tip: Book the stargazing experience at the observatory – Primland's remote location and 3,000-foot elevation make it one of the best spots on the East Coast for celestial viewing, with minimal light pollution.
dont_miss: The exhilarating zipline canopy tour that soars through ancient hardwood forests, and a visit to nearby Mabry Mill on the Blue Ridge Parkway – one of the most photographed spots in America, especially stunning during fall foliage season.
pros: Spectacular Blue Ridge Mountain setting with panoramic views
Extensive outdoor activities including golf, fishing, and hiking
cons: Remote mountain location requires scenic drive
